## Prompt Evaluation: STA-410 (No Description, No Labels)

### Criteria Assessment

| Criterion | Result | Notes |

### Key Failures

1. **Step 1 is a lie**: "Read the issue description carefully" when there is no description creates false confidence — the agent may invent context.

You are working on Linear issue STA-410: Fix typo in error message

Recommended first step: search the codebase for error message strings
